title: 木造在来 1/50 平面詳細図 作図ルール (社内練習データ 住宅A から抽出)

derivedFrom.environment: 住宅A 1/50 平面詳細 JWF
derivedFrom.reference: 住宅A 平面・立面・断面詳細 PDF
derivedFrom.method: codec decode + per-layer raster review + line-offset measurement around grid lines (2026-10-01)
derivedFrom.privacy: Rules only. No client names, addresses or drawing contents are stored here.

layerNames: Groups use names n-0..n-7, n-9, n-A, n-C for numbered layers; fixed names: 8=ハッチ, B=色塗, D=文字, E=寸法, F=補助線

meaning.1: 中線: 建具・外装下地の境界
meaning.2: 太線: 壁の最外面と室内仕上げ面 (切断面の輪郭)
meaning.3: 極細グレー: 補助グリッド
meaning.4: 細線: 壁の中間層境界・家具
meaning.7: グレー: 設備機器・通り芯
meaning.8: ピンク: 断熱材パターン

rules: 通り芯 (column centre lines) must sit on multiples of 455 from the first grid line; prefer 910 multiples for main structure.
Every exterior wall vertex, interior wall end, column and wall junction is on the 455 grid.
Room sizes are planned centre-to-centre in grid units: 4.5帖 = 2,730 x 2,730, 6帖 = 2,730 x 3,640, 8帖 = 3,640 x 3,640.
Corridors are 910 centre-to-centre (clear ~780); stairs and toilets use 910 width.

Grid-to-grid dimension values must be multiples of 455. Non-module values (e.g. 899, 702, 1,130) are only allowed for opening positions/sizes and must be shown in a separate opening-position tier or in parentheses as reference dimensions.
Opening widths follow the module: 1間 window/sliding door 1,820 centre, 半間 910; sash call sizes (e.g. 16520) are product sizes inside the module opening.

1:0.rule: Covers the building extent every 455 mm in both directions.

1:1.rule: Outermost exterior face and every interior finished face. Cut walls must read as two thick lines.

1:2.rule: 105x105 square with an X (block 柱1) at wall corners, junctions and opening jambs on the 910 grid.

1:3.ja: 壁 躯体・下地境界 (細線)
1:3.rule: Stud faces (±52.5 from grid) and exterior sheathing face.

1:4.ja: 外壁 下地層 (通気胴縁・付加断熱)
1:4.rule: Exterior-only lines at -62 and -152 from grid.

1:5.rule: Sash frames, door leaves and swing arcs. Wall lines stop at the opening.

1:6.ja: 設備機器 (UB・便器・キッチン・洗濯機・AC)

1:7.ja: 家具 (ベッド・テーブル・ソファ・収納棚)
1:7.rule: Movable furniture is dashed so it never competes with walls.

1:8.ja: ハッチ (玄関土間タイル等)

1:9.ja: 記号 (感知器・換気扇・ガラリ・筋交い・方位)

1:A.ja: 通り芯 / 断熱材パターン
1:A.rule: 通り芯 one-dot chain at 910 pitch labelled X1.. / Y1.. (3.5 mm text) in circle bubbles; insulation wave pattern inside exterior stud cavity, clipped at openings.

1:C.rule: Hatch between -62 and -152 band (PF 90) on exterior walls only, clipped at openings and corners.

pen.note: SXF colour index 12 (lightgreen) in the office header

1:D.ja: 文字 (室名・面積・注記・建具番号)
1:D.rule: Room name in a 1-line box (lines pen 1; text style 8 = 3.0 mm, box height 3.6 mm, 0.5 mm side padding, white solid mask on 1:B behind). Area below as "N.NN㎡" in style 7 (2.2 mm), centred, baseline 3.0 mm under the box. Areas are wall-centreline (壁芯) areas.

1:E.rule: Three tiers outside the building: grid-to-grid (910/455 pieces), groups, overall. Values in mm with thousands separator.

exterior-wood-sided.ja: 外壁: 金属サイディング15 / 胴縁18 / 付加断熱PF90 / 石膏板9.5 / 柱105 (GW充填) / 石膏ボード12.5

linesFromGridMm.what: サイディング外面 (太線)
石膏ボード室内面 (太線)

interior.ja: 内壁: 柱/間柱105 + 両面石膏ボード12.5 = 130

finishingRules: Wall face lines meet cleanly at corners and T-junctions (包絡処理): no overshoot, no gaps.
All wall lines, insulation patterns and hatches stop at both jambs of an opening.
Insulation is drawn only in exterior walls; interior walls stay empty between the thin core lines.
Furniture (1:7) is dashed color 4; fixed equipment (1:6) is solid gray color 7; neither touches wall lines.
Never mix roles on one layer: text only on 1:D (except grid labels on 1:A), dimensions only on 1:E.
Grid and aux grid are drawn first and span the full building with margin; walls are placed on the 910/455 grid.

evaluation.implementation: addons/jw-assistant/generator/evaluate.mjs (deterministic; drafting checks read the JWW back, planning checks use the resolved spec geometry)

measured.method: Codec decode of practice house A plan, coordinates relative to grid X1/Y1 (model mm = file mm x 50). 2026-10-01.

grid.note: Long 通り芯 are NOT drawn through the plan; 1:0 aux grid (pen 3 dotted) spans only the building outline at every 910 plus the 455 lines actually used.

dimensions.ticks: 実点 (CDataTen, pen 1) at every break point; no arrows
dimensions.extension: solid pen 1 from the tier to (outer face - 801), then chain pen 4 style 5 to (outer face - 101)
dimensions.tiers: opening positions (innermost, only if off-module) / grid-to-grid 455 multiples / overall

walls.exteriorBand: union body -185..+65; thick faces (1:1 pen 2) at -185 and +65 meet with mitred corners; -170 siding back (1:1 pen 4); battens -152/-62 (1:4 pen 1); stud faces ±52.5 (1:3 pen 4) broken at every column face
walls.interior: faces ±65 (1:1 pen 2), cores ±52.5 (1:3 pen 4) broken at columns
walls.tJunction: the through wall face is broken between the joining wall faces; the joining wall faces stop on the through wall face (no overshoot); a column sits on the junction

column.placement: every exterior corner, every wall junction and free wall end, both jambs of every opening, and along exterior walls at <= 1,820 (observed 910-1,820)

insulation.pattern: zig-zag between v=-35 and v=+35, vertices every 17.5 along the wall; semicircles R17.5 join every second vertex (bulge to ±52.5)
insulation.limits: between column faces / opening jambs (-12.5) only; exterior walls only

addedInsulationHatch.clipped: at the 45 x 90 batten blocks 45 mm outside each rough opening; continuous round corners

lines.battenBlock: 45 x 90 rectangle (pen 5) + diagonal (pen 1) at both ends between -152 and -62

windowSliding.wallStops: outer face/siding stop at RO; inner face stops at RO + 16.5

doorSwing.jambBox: 24 deep x (wall + 2 x 12.5) wide, pen 2, at both jambs
doorSwing.leaf: 33 thick (entrance 45), two long sides pen 5, outer face 2.5 beyond the wall face on the swing side
doorSwing.arc: pen 1, centre at hinge, radius = leaf length (clear - 48), from closed leaf end to open position
doorSwing.openLine: pen 2 along the hinge jamb from the far jamb box edge to the arc end

measured.doorSliding: jamb boxes as above; leaf 30 thick inside the wall plane at v 3.5..33.5 (pen 5); the generator adds the open position dashed
measured.entranceDoor: outward opening (radius ~910), frame ~980; tile hatch 300 pitch on 1:8 pen 4 in the 土間, 框 line on 1:8
